scope: Four shared redstone/capability input paths, each present all20 frozen contexts. Templates are ignored staging recovery inputs only, not production sources. No environment/key/preset selects old source; MC cases reflect API differences and independent feature flags represent D2 behavior/doc changes.

conceptual_name_correction.proof: Offline git grep -n -w of both names across all20 frozen src trees returned zero matches; ls-tree confirms no such source files.

normalization_contract: Reject lone CR; replace each CRLF with LF; append one terminal LF only when originally absent. Do not trim whitespace, remove/add other blank lines, alter tokens or reinterpret Java. Raw and normalized witnesses remain separately pinned.

redstone_live_read.purpose: Fresh read-only world signal query, side convention, buffer exclusion and fallback priority; independent from stored counters.

redstone_buffer_storage.purpose: Private counter value, positive real-transfer notifications and clamped NBT load. Consumer callback/persistence closure is separate.

redstone_signal_documentation.purpose: Correct only the two canExtract/canReceive documentation descriptions; independent from runtime behavior.

existing_image_feature: IMAGE_HANDLER is guarded by existing image_resources, separate from all redstone flags.

genuine_api_groups.provider: Before1.20.3 the fallback SFM provider returns snapshot RedstoneSignalStorage; NeoForge1.20.3+ additionally implements IBlockCapabilityProvider with a Level-based query. D2 live behavior uses IRedstoneSignalStorage and must not be disguised as an MC guard.
genuine_api_groups.storage: Forge INBTSerializable up to1.20.1; NeoForge INBTSerializable from1.20.2;1.21+ HolderLookup.Provider signatures;26 ValueIOSerializable/ValueInput/ValueOutput.
genuine_api_groups.well_known: ForgeCapabilities/CapabilityToken staticget before1.20.2; NeoForge legacy Capabilities/CapabilityManager1.20.2; block capabilities1.20.3+;26 EnergyHandler/ResourceHandler transfer API.

consumer_constraints.lexical_evidence_method: Offline git grep -n -w at exact20 source commits; path lists include declarations/tests, not complete semantic closure.
boundaries: Baseline paths remain present unconditionally; redstone flags alter members/behavior, not whole resource-type existence.

Live provider depends on existing SFMBlockCapabilityProvider.priority(), SFMDirections, BufferBlock and real world query methods. The provider must remain lower priority than actual buffer storage; live/read-only observation is not inventory transfer.

redstone_buffer_storage changes value from public to private and introduces protected onContentsChanged(). RedstoneResourceType anonymous subclass plus BufferBlockEntityContents callback/persistence need their own matching owner guards before enabled Java/runtime acceptance.
Capability discovery signal-source and buffer-source membership decisions are separately owned companions and are not authored here.
image_resources selection needs real IImageHandler and capability-registration closure; this slice does not produce Java stubs.

The26 frozen deserialize(ValueInput) ignores the getInt return value. Preserve this baseline behavior exactly; a future correctness fix must have separate authority/owner/evidence, not silent migration cleanup.

stage_preview_proof.method: Independent strict whole-line if/case preview over physical staged UTF-8 LF inputs, compared against bounded raw Git SHA1/SHA256 witnesses after the exact approved normalization.
stage_preview_proof.limit: Authoring reconstruction evidence only; does not replace the post-promotion production renderer/selector test gate.

regression_module.execution: not_run_by_subagent; root owns Cargo and gate
planned_contracts: 80 pinned raw/normalized full source outputs and all-target membership
15 strict normalization transforms with exact CRLF/finalLF counts and lone-CR refusal
128 independent D2 member-feature outputs, no implicit feature/prerequisite synthesis
older target API signatures and unsupported D2 flags fail closed
normalization preserves26 baseline deserialize behavior and Java internal whitespace
descriptive release/dev and arbitrary nested keys do not change MC/source ownership

recovery_policy: Do not auto-delete or overwrite staged recovery inputs. Root promotion must verify recorded template hashes and existing fail-closed destination semantics.
deferred_acceptance: No core/src, shared metadata, registered Rust, lock/dependency or production historical lookup changes.
No complete Java build, read-query, counter persistence, capability invalidation or in-game acceptance claim.
Feature flags have empty prerequisites only for this bounded carrier/member slice; later real consumer closure must be checked before widening enabled manifests.
